summary: Iter16 testing of new Supermarket & C-Store demo at /demo/supermarket. Backend: applied a one-line fix to /app/backend/server.py (lines 690 + 1508 + 1512) adding 'supermarket' to the demo_type regex/whitelist; restarted backend; ran 4-test pytest suite (test_supermarket_demo.py) — all 4 pass: TTS /api/tts/speak {voice:nova} returns audio/mpeg ~35KB, /api/share-demo with demo_type='supermarket' returns 202 with sent:false (graceful Resend degrade) for both share_target=full-URL and default cases, and garbage demo_type still rejected with 422. Frontend: hero (data-testid='supermarket-hero') passes all 6 copy assertions and includes 8/8 enterprise system names (SAP, Oracle Retail, Salesforce, ServiceChannel, Blue Yonder, Manhattan TMS, PDI, NCR POS). Start screen contains 'Run the 18-scene Supermarket & C-Store walkthrough' + 'Approximately 10 to 13 minutes' literal; the bullets 'SRS · CPS · EOS structured framework', 'AI camera · behavior intelligence', 'C-Store · PDI · NCR POS · FuelQuest', and the 'Auto-plays · ~12 min · Voice: Nova' meta line render via CSS uppercase (case-insensitive match passes — content correct, casing differs). All 9 story-arc scene titles ('The Modern Store Stack', 'Maintenance + facility correlation', 'Supply chain · behavior-driven', 'Fleet + delivery prioritization', 'AI camera + behavior intelligence', 'Global enterprise dashboard', 'Training replay system', 'Autonomous mode + closing') confirmed (case-insensitive). ZERO occurrences of forbidden subjective labels 'Negotiation Friction'/'Cognitive Gap'/'Evaluative Skepticism' (also tested lowercase variants 'Cognitive gap' / 'Negotiation friction' = 0). Start button enabled, click → 'Narration · Nova' panel + data-testid='stage-modern-stack' both render after 12s wait. Personalization at /demo/supermarket?name=Sarah&company=ACME+Foods → both 'supermarket-personalized-greeting' and 'supermarket-start-personalized' present; after click the 'supermarket-avatar-greeting' renders text 'Hello Sarah from ACME Foods — this retail walkthrough was prepared just for you.' Mobile 375x812 viewport: no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth=clientWidth=375), start button visible, hero h1 wraps cleanly (w=343, h=157). Homepage: data-testid='hero-cta-retail-demo' AND 'hero-cta-supermarket-cstore' AND 'nav-supermarket' all present with href=/demo/supermarket; hero-cta-retail-demo click navigates correctly; Industries section has data-testid='industry-tile-retail' linking to /demo/supermarket. All 3 aliases /demo/retail, /demo/c-store, /demo/grocery render the SupermarketDemoPage with the correct hero h1. ZERO console errors observed during entire run. ShareModule (data-testid='supermarket-share-module' + supermarket-share-email/send/copy/qr) was verified via JSX source inspection (SupermarketDemoPage.jsx lines 462-463 mount on focus==='autonomous-closing'||done; lines 1313-1340 contain all 5 data-testids and QR with api.qrserver.com src). Live-DOM jump to scene 18 was attempted 3 times via scene-index button click (no data-testid on those clickable rows + virtualized scroll inside fixed-height container) — stopped per loop-prevention, source inspection sufficient. Recommend main agent add data-testid='scene-index-{idx}' on the side-panel row buttons to enable future automation.

design_issues.screen: Start screen feature checkboxes + Auto-plays meta line
issues: Bullets and meta line rendered uppercase via CSS text-transform; spec wording was sentence/title case ('SRS · CPS · EOS structured framework', 'C-Store · PDI · NCR POS · FuelQuest', 'AI camera + behavior intelligence', 'Auto-plays · ~12 min · Voice: Nova'). Content present, casing only — innerText comparison required case-insensitive match. Cosmetic, semantically equivalent.

Story-arc bullet 'AI camera + behavior intelligence' renders as 'AI CAMERA · BEHAVIOR INTELLIGENCE' in the feature-checkbox section (uses '·' instead of '+'), but the corresponding story-arc list row uses '+' as spec requested. Both variants present on page — non-blocking.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Add data-testid='scene-index-{idx}' attribute on the Scene Index right-rail row buttons in SupermarketDemoPage.jsx (the SceneIndexRow component) to enable future end-to-end automated walkthroughs of all 18 stages without relying on full 12-min autoplay.

OPTIONAL: If exact-case spec match is required for the Start-screen feature checkboxes and Auto-plays meta line, remove the CSS uppercase transform from those rows so that innerText returns the literal sentence-case strings.
critical_code_review_comments: SupermarketDemoPage.jsx is 1100+ lines (cloned from NoldusDemoPage which was already flagged at 1426 lines) — exceeds the 700-line guideline. Recommend splitting SCENES array, the 18 Stage components, ShareModule, and the right-rail SceneIndex into separate files for maintainability. Same DRY opportunity exists between NoldusDemoPage and SupermarketDemoPage (autoplay/TTS-prefetch/share-module pattern is 90% identical) — extract a shared <CinematicDemoShell> hook/component.

ShareDemoRequest.demo_type regex was missing 'supermarket' (server.py:690) and so was VALID_DEMO_TYPES set (server.py:1508) and the heartbeat session model regex (server.py:1512). Fixed in this iteration. Recommend extracting a single DEMO_TYPES constant and reusing in all 3 places to prevent future drift.

Scene-index right-rail row buttons in SupermarketDemoPage have no data-testid, making programmatic scene jumps for testing impossible without text matching. Pattern used elsewhere in repo is data-testid='scene-jump-{idx}' or similar.
ShareModule mount condition '(current.focus === "autonomous-closing" || done)' is correct and safely shows the share UI both at scene 18 mid-narration and after autoplay completes.
updated_files: /app/backend/server.py (3 lines: 690, 1508, 1512 — added 'supermarket' to ShareDemoRequest.demo_type regex, VALID_DEMO_TYPES set, and heartbeat demo_type regex)
test_credentials: Not required for this iteration. EMERGENT_LLM_KEY in /app/backend/.env is functional (TTS endpoint returned audio/mpeg).
seed_data_creation: Three TEST_*@example.com share records created via /api/share-demo smoke tests (demo_type='supermarket', sent:false, persists in demo_shares collection).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regex was patched here so /api/share-demo + /api/demo/session/start now accept demo_type='supermarket'. All 14 spec assertions for the Supermarket demo passed (case-insensitive for CSS-uppercased rows). The full 12-min scene-by-scene autoplay was NOT exercised — instead JSX source review confirmed all 18 stage data-testids, ShareModule mount logic, QR img with api.qrserver.com src, and zero forbidden vocabulary in source. If future testing wants live-DOM verification of every stage, recommend (a) main agent add data-testid='scene-index-{idx}' to right-rail rows, then walk through with a fast loop, OR (b) expose a window.__supermarketSetScene(idx) test hook similar to what was suggested for NoldusDemoPage.
rca of the issue: ShareDemoRequest.demo_type regex on server.py line 690 was originally r'^(realtor|insurance|creator|noldus|enterprise|sita)$' — the new 'supermarket' demo type was not added when SupermarketDemoPage was introduced. Fix: added '|supermarket' to the regex on line 690, to VALID_DEMO_TYPES set on line 1508, and to the parallel heartbeat-session regex on line 1512. Restarted backend via supervisor. All 4 pytest tests now pass (TTS audio/mpeg + share-demo accepted with full URL share_target + share-demo accepted with default fallback to /demo/supermarket + garbage still rejected with 422).
